purpose: Tag T5 antenna delay calibration, against T1 held FIXED at 16428. Full correction attributed to T5 alone. First DWM1001 tag calibrated -- previous three (T2, T3, T4) were all ESP32 UWB Pro.
method: T5 temporarily role=RESP, slot_index=7, RESET to force live re-dispatch. T1 (0x8052, ESP32) stayed INIT/frame_index 0, ant_delay untouched at 16428 throughout. 60s windows throughout.

passes.note: Deficit far larger than any ESP32 tag (10-90mm) -- expected, not anomalous: T5 is a DWM1001, a different DW1000 module/antenna integration than T1's ESP32, so a materially different intrinsic antenna delay is normal, not a fault.

note: T5's calibrated value (16473) differs from every ESP32 tag's (16428-16443) by 30-45 units -- consistent with genuinely different hardware, not measurement noise (the correction converged cleanly to a residual within 1 SEM). Worth expecting the same pattern for T6, the other DWM1001 tag.
